notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible: two separately manipulated upper-cabinet doors and two drawers. The two upper-door closures occur close together and their individual ordering is less visually clear than the drawer transitions.
scene_description: A user surveys a compact kitchen, opens both hinged doors of the storage cabinet above the refrigerator, then opens a food drawer left of the stove and a separate storage drawer right of the stove. The upper cabinet doors are closed first, followed later by the left and right drawers.
